tagline: Teach a framework like a whiteboard: an animated diagram on top, one word at a time in the middle, your face in a rounded window below, and a hard cut to your face on every claim.
readiness_note: best with a 4K landscape take: the full-face punches are a crop of it

captions: Hook: lockup with a crimson key phrase, a phone card whose curve drops, one-word caption, face window
The recurring loop diagram: node 2 lit, hero numeral and step name
The full-face punch: one big word, an italic-serif keyword swap
